subject: general
question: Which state / union territory had the highest urbanisation in 2011, as per the Census of India data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Delhi had the highest urbanisation rate in India as per the 2011 Census data, with **97.5% of its population living in urban areas**.
 
• The Census of India defines urbanisation as the percentage of the population living in areas officially classified as urban.
 
• The high urbanisation rate in Delhi is attributed to its status as the capital city of India, serving as a hub for governance, trade, industry, education, and migration.
 
• Delhi is characterized by densely populated metropolitan areas, including New Delhi, and is home to diverse employment opportunities and better infrastructure.
 
• Urbanisation in Delhi has been driven by rural-to-urban migration, especially from nearby states such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Haryana, and Punjab, seeking better livelihoods and opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urbanisation in India**

 
 
• Urbanisation refers to the increase in the percentage of a population living in urban areas, typically driven by economic development and migration.
 
• India's urbanisation rate in 2011 was approximately **31.16%**, with significant variation between states and Union Territories.
 
• Factors influencing urbanisation include industrialization, better infrastructure, employment opportunities, and improved living standards.
